verdict.rationale: The evidence does not explicitly name any official client SDK library. The docs instead describe the Terminal API as JSON messaging "without the need for libraries." The closest support is Adyen's official OpenAPI definitions repo on GitHub, from which typed clients could be generated, plus a Tap to Pay on iPhone build path that implies a mobile integration component without calling it an SDK. Missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDKs (server-side language libraries, iOS/Android SDKs), SDK reference docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of SDK use for in-person payments.
